P0000.rationale: Subsection (c) specifies that using a hand-held mobile telephone is permissible by drivers of a CMV when necessary to communicate with law enforcement officials or other emergency services, qualifying the driver prohibition in (a)(1) (C0000). It does not qualify the motor carrier prohibition in (a)(2) (C0001) to permit motor carriers to allow or require drivers to use hand-held mobile telephones. Targeting C0001 as a qualified baseline is unsupported by the text.

source_spans.quote: (a)(1) No driver shall use a hand-held mobile telephone while driving a CMV.
(2) No motor carrier shall allow or require its drivers to use a hand-held mobile telephone while driving a CMV.
(c) Emergency exception. Using a hand-held mobile telephone is permissible by drivers of a CMV when necessary to communicate with law enforcement officials or other emergency services.
